subject: Private Offer Request — Starlit AI (AWS listing) — exec review needed
messages:
From: Anna Park <anna@starlit.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@starlit.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer — AWS listing / special commercial request

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Starlit is ready to move forward with a private AWS listing but we need two one-time concessions to make procurement sign: a $75k onboarding credit and a temporary SLA tweak for the first 6 months (99.5% to 99.0%) while we ramp. We also asked for net60 payment terms for the first invoice and a 35% rev-share carveout on usage driven incentives for the first year.

I attached a short summary (Requirements) and the pricing sheet from our side. Can you let us know if Redwood can accommodate? We appreciate any flexibility — procurement is sensitive to cashflow and ramp risk.

Best,
Anna Park
Head of Platform Partnerships | Starlit AI
anna@starlit.ai

Attachment: Starlit-Requirement-Specs.pdf (summary, 2 pages)
Attachment: Proposed-Pricing-v3.xlsx (pricing mockup)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Anna Park <anna@starlit.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer — AWS listing / special commercial request

Hi Anna — thank you, and congrats on the momentum.

Quick read of your asks:
- One-time onboarding credit: $75k
- SLA: temporary reduction to 99.0% for 6 months
- Payment terms: net60 for first invoice
- Rev-share: 35% carveout on usage-driven incentives for 12 months

I need to escalate to deal desk + exec sign-off for the rev-share carveout and the SLA deviation. I’ll share this with Marissa (Head of Sales Ops), Karthik (Marketplace Lead), and Jonas (Finance) to get a decision. Expect an internal response by EOD — I’ll follow up with a single ask summary and our recommended path.

Separately: can you confirm expected ARR in year 1 and whether the onboarding credit is refundable if the deal doesn’t close? That’ll help finance.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Private offer — Starlit AI (AWS) — exec approval request

Team — forwarding Starlit’s request (attachments included). TL;DR: they asked for three exceptions tied to a private AWS listing: $75k one-time onboarding credit, temporary SLA drop to 99.0% for six months, net60 first invoice, and a 35% rev-share carveout for year one.

Why this matters: Starlit is a seed-to-series B platform with strong usage growth. If we win the listing they will drive considerable consumption in Q4 and into next year; their product is tightly aligned to our embeddings/real-time use cases.

My recommended path (to accelerate):
- Approve one-time onboarding credit up to $75k (accounted as contra-revenue, refundable if no listing executes within 90 days)
- Approve net60 for first invoice only, then standard net30 thereafter
- Do NOT approve rev-share carveout at 35%; propose keeping standard rev-share but offer a capped rebate structure tied to attainment (e.g., 10% back on incremental usage above a baseline)
- SLA: allow temporary 99.0% for 6 months if we add explicit rollback and detailed runbook + monitoring requirements

Questions for approval: 1) Marissa — commercial ok? 2) Karthik — any impact on marketplace listing/routing? 3) Jonas — finance impact + refund construct?

Attachments: Starlit-Requirement-Specs.pdf, Proposed-Pricing-v3.xlsx

— Grace

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer — Starlit AI (AWS) — exec approval request

Thanks Grace — I like your framing. Short answer: I approve the one-time onboarding credit up to $75k with the refund-if-not-listed clause. Approve net60 for the first invoice.

On the rev-share: I will not greenlight a 35% carveout. Accept the capped rebate approach (10% rebate on incremental usage above baseline for first 12 months) as you suggested — that keeps long-term unit economics intact.

SLA: I can approve the temporary 99.0% for six months provided we include an automatic rollback to standard SLA after 6 months and put in the runbook + run-rate monthly reporting as conditions. Also require a credit cap (no more than 3 months' average ARR in credits).

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer — Starlit AI (AWS) — exec approval request

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of add-ons from Marketplace POV:
- If we keep standard rev-share + capped rebate, we should add a 12-month usage baseline to avoid gaming and include an audit right for Redwood on reported usage for rebate calculation.
- I prefer net30 after the first invoice rather than net60 (Grace/Marissa have agreed net60 for first invoice). Can we make the refund window for the onboarding credit 60 days post-listing (rather than 90) to reduce outstanding contra-revenue exposure?

If finance signs off on the shortened refund window, I’m fine with the rest. I’ll coordinate the listing config so the offer can be activated quickly once legal finishes the T&Cs.

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Marketplace Product Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Anna Park <anna@starlit.ai>, procurement@starlit.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer — AWS listing / special commercial request

Anna — thanks for your patience. Internal approvers signed off with the following commercial exceptions:

1) One-time onboarding credit: $75,000 (credited upon listing activation). Refund clause: refundable if the listing does not go live within 60 days; credit will be recorded as contra-revenue.
2) Payment terms: net60 for the first invoice only; subsequent invoices net30.
3) Rev-share: no 35% carveout. Instead Redwood will provide a capped incremental usage rebate: 10% rebate on incremental usage above a mutually agreed baseline for 12 months. Rebate calculation will include audit rights for Redwood.
4) SLA: temporary 99.0% target for first six months; automatic rollback to standard SLA (as defined in our standard listing T&Cs) after six months. A runbook and monthly run-rate reporting are required. Credit cap for SLA incidents: no more than 3 months' average ARR.

Next steps:
- Anna, please confirm acceptance of the commercial outline and sign the attached term sheet.
- Legal will draft the private offer terms (I’ve looped in Legal separately).
- Karthik will provision the AWS listing once terms are signed.

If that works, we’ll issue the onboarding credit on activation and proceed to listing.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Grace.oconnor@redwood.com

Attachment: Term-sheet-starlit-redwood-aws-v1.pdf (to follow via DocuSign)
